name: bountystash-console
description: Modern Brutalist 3D Spatial Systems Console & Workstation adhering strictly to the 14KB TCP envelope rule

scripts.preview: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{const p=path.join(__dirname,'dist',req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url);if(fs.existsSync(p)){res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':p.endsWith('.html')?'text/html':p.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');}});server.listen(3000,()=>console.log('⚡ Preview server live at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Matt Ji <matt@bountystash.com>
